instructions:
1. Step onto the pedals and place your feet securely, then grip the moving handles.
2. Begin striding in a smooth elliptical motion, pushing and pulling the handles with your arms.
3. Build up to a fast pace while keeping movements controlled and your posture upright.
4. Drive through your legs and engage your glutes on each stride.
5. Maintain the fast pace for the set duration.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced and torso upright, do not lean on the handles.
2. Push through the whole foot to recruit the glutes and hamstrings.
3. Breathe in a steady rhythm with your stride.
4. Raise resistance or incline to increase glute activation.
name: Gym Elliptical Machine Fast Speed

instructions:
1. Step onto the pedals and place your feet securely, then grip the moving handles.
2. Begin striding in a smooth elliptical motion, pushing and pulling the handles with your arms.
3. Accelerate to an all-out sprint pace while keeping movements controlled.
4. Drive hard through your legs and engage your glutes on each stride.
5. Sustain the sprint pace for the set interval, then ease off.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced and torso upright, do not lean on the handles.
2. Push through the whole foot to recruit the glutes and hamstrings.
3. Match your breathing to the high effort with strong, rhythmic breaths.
4. Use short intervals to maintain sprint quality.
name: Gym Elliptical Machine Sprint Speed

instructions:
1. Sit on the rower, strap in your feet, and grip the handle with an overhand grip, knees bent.
2. Drive through your legs to push your body back, keeping your arms straight.
3. As your legs near full extension, lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower ribs.
4. Extend your arms first, then bend your knees to slide forward to the start.
5. Repeat the stroke at a fast pace for the set duration.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back straight and core braced, do not round your spine.
2. Power each stroke with your legs first, then back, then arms.
3. Exhale on the drive and inhale on the recovery.
4. Keep the recovery slower than the drive to control rhythm.
name: Gym Rowing Machine Fast Speed
